title: Forecast: Data plane CPU - Threshold Nearing Limit
summary: AgenticOps forecasts that Data Plane CPU usage will reach the configured threshold in <random_number> days.

analysis.detail: Data Plane CPU usage is forecasted to reach the firewall configured threshold, posing a significant risk of performance degradation and packet loss if left unaddressed. This forecast highlights upcoming strain on the data plane so action can be taken before service disruption occurs for 'ftd_16'.

probableCauses.detail: High Data Plane CPU usage is often due to heavy traffic, complex access control policies, resource-intensive deep packet inspection, or inefficient security configurations, cryptographic operations, connection rate spikes, or insufficient hardware capacity for current workload demands.

remediation.title: Implement targeted remediation strategies to reduce Data Plane CPU utilization and ensure optimal firewall performance.
remediation.markdownText:
### Optimize access control policies

Optimize access control policies by consolidating rules, removing unused policies, and prioritizing frequently matched rules. Use object groups to simplify rule evaluation and reduce the computational load on the data plane.

### Adjust inspection settings

Review deep packet inspection and intrusion prevention settings to balance security and performance. Exclude trusted traffic, lower sensitivity for non-critical applications, or use performance-based profiles during peak periods.

### Enable traffic distribution

Use load balancing or clustering to distribute traffic across multiple firewall devices, increasing processing capacity and providing redundancy. In high-availability setups, ensure traffic is evenly distributed to avoid overloading any single device.

### Review cryptographic operations

If VPN or SSL/TLS inspection is enabled, check that hardware acceleration is properly configured. Offload cryptographic tasks to dedicated hardware, optimize cipher suites, and use selective decryption policies as needed.

### Monitor connection rates

Monitor connection rates and apply rate limiting to high-volume sources to prevent resource exhaustion from connection floods. Adjust timeout values to free up resources from idle connections more efficiently.
